objects.name: idx_checkins_slot
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_checkins_slot ON checkins (task_id, date, slot_index)

objects.name: idx_slots_due
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_slots_due ON slots (due_date, due_time)

objects.name: change_logs
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "change_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "changed_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("synced" IN (0, 1)))

objects.name: checkins
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "checkins" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "slot_index" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "done_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "due_at_minute_of_day" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "photo_path" TEXT NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

objects.name: members
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "avatar_id" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

objects.name: settings
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"))

objects.name: slots
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "slots" ("task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "slot_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_time" TEXT NOT NULL, "remind_id" INTEGER NULL, "followup_id" INTEGER NULL, "followup_sent" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("followup_sent" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("task_id", "date", "slot_index"))

objects.name: tasks
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "member_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES members (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "icon_id" TEXT NULL, "repeat_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "time_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "course_start" TEXT NULL, "course_end" TEXT NULL, "course_total_days" INTEGER NULL, "rules_effective_from" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "reminder_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("reminder_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
